description: Pass rules of D30's visual localization of consented photos (crowd3d.localize): result B of compare (benchmark.py rescore --localize of the D31 fresh runs) against result A (the same rescore without --localize, from the same commit), on each split (dev, test) the results record. They decide whether Settings.localize_photos may be switched on (D30 step 11). Written before the B runs (D30 design, verification plan item 4). Judged by compare --criteria d30-v1 --noise-factor 0: A and B score the same SfM artefacts, so run-to-run noise does not enter a difference (min_delta still applies). The checks below the rules read the run artefacts, loc.json and several results at once; they are judged outside compare. docs/BENCHMARK.md section 6.12.

baseline.B: The same four commands with --localize and the names d30-b, d30-b, d30-b-dev, d30-b-test, from the same clean commit as A (A is run again on that commit: the scratch d30-a results of D30 step 2 predate photo_pose_loc_wrong and steps 3-9). Both with --reference-cache <scratch>/d31/fresh/refs/<testset> (India Gate at reference version 2) and the D31 artefacts as recorded (artefacts_dir); --allow-recon-diff is not needed (the D31 runs made reconstruction output version 2). One building at a time, one COLMAP process, nice 19, 2 threads (crowd3d.localize.LOCALIZE_THREADS).

decisions: D30 (owner, 2026-11-04): other people see a consented photo's pose rounded to 1 m and 1 deg, placed as precisely as possible, and never a crude guess: no pose rather than a crude one. Visual localization (PnP of a photo no shown model places into a saved map, EXIF focal length fixed) is shown only if it adds poses without adding wrong ones.

The gate is the D30 design's (cross.verification item 4), written before any localizer existed: must hold 0 wrong localized poses at 10 m / 15 deg among photos with a reference pose, pooled over dev and test and including the loc_with_gps_conflict subset; 0 wrong-face localized poses on every building and repeat; photo_pose_wrong_share not worse than A; localization CPU at most 25 % of the run's CPU. Reported, not blocking: the loc 2-sigma coverage with its Wilson interval (INSUFFICIENT allowed under 10 photos) and the photo_pose_correct_rate_testset gain. The evaluation design's 'better on dev' primary is not a rule: it would block a harmless feature at the predicted gain of a few photos, which contradicts 'must not waste'.

photo_pose_loc_wrong (photo_pose_loc_gt - photo_pose_loc_correct) was added to metric schema 8 in place for this gate, before any schema-8 result was committed. Both zero rules take the largest value over each building's repeats (compare's zero rule), so 'zero on every building and repeat of both splits' is exactly 'zero pooled over dev and test'.

Buildings without a reference pose: pose_metrics gives every reference metric of such a building as none (Sydney Opera House on the test split: no verified reference pose for any photo), so a plain zero rule would be INSUFFICIENT on the test split for any B, and with it the verdict (no value: sydney-opera-house), which would keep localize_photos off whatever the localizer does. Both zero rules therefore read {"zero": true, "skip_without": "photo_pose_gt"}: a building with no photo_pose_gt in any repeat is left out and named in the row; a building with a reference pose but no value still makes the rule INSUFFICIENT, and a split with no building left is INSUFFICIENT. Changed in this file before any B run (D30 step 9 review); a localized pose on Sydney Opera House could not be judged anyway (no reference), and it has no map (decisions below).

Paired comparison: A and B come from one commit and the same recorded artefacts, so every difference between them is the localizer's (check only_loc_changes). With --noise-factor 0 a relative rule's threshold is the metric's min_delta: 0.01 for photo_pose_wrong_share, judged pooled and on every building; with the hard zero gate a localized pose can only lower a building's wrong share, so this rule can fail only together with photo_pose_loc_wrong.

What is scored: photoposes.public_row of the internal pose, the product's rule with Settings.localize_photos on (jobs.shown_localizations: every accepted localization is shown); the localizer's records come from the product's own candidate_maps, eligible, load_sparse_maps and ColmapLocalizer.localize (with its pair selection), keyed by the candidate maps as a localize job keys them, with the snaps the poses are scored with and the consent the scoring assumes for these runs (every accepted upload: their stores predate the consent, provenance location_consent). The harness scores every photo at the end of the run; /poses lists only photos uploaded before the last reconstruction job ended (as_of): check fresh_run_display_equals_score covers that difference.

Cost (photo_pose_loc_cpu_s, max_share 0.25 of cpu_time_s per split, B alone): the process CPU of each repeat's localize call. The runs kept no feature cache, so features are extracted again: the map photos' features first, into a cache of the repeat (from a store shared by the building's repeats; their CPU is poses.runs[].loc.map_features.cpu_s, not the metric, because a live run's reconstruction jobs leave them in the landmark's cache); the localizer then extracts the queries' features and matches every pair itself. No repeat borrows another repeat's queries or pairs, so r2 is measured as r1 is. cpu_time_s is the source run's, copied. This is neither bound of a live run's localization CPU: a live landmark cache also holds the pairs its reconstruction jobs matched (less work), while a live run tries photos again whenever the candidate maps change (more work); check loc_cost_live reports the live figure of one fresh run next to it.

In-sample: the localizer's gates (docs/VISUAL_LOCALIZATION.md 3.4-3.9) were set on the Florence Baptistery before D30; the D30 steps 7-8 smoke runs (product localizer on copies of the D31 runs) were seen before this file was written: synthetic-two-sides r1, India Gate test r1, Leaning Tower of Pisa dev r1, Florence Baptistery dev r1, Hungarian Parliament test r1. The gate's thresholds are the design's and were not changed after them. D31's thresholds were chosen after looking at the five test buildings, so the test split is not held out for D30 either (docs/BENCHMARK.md section 2).

Where the localizer cannot add anything: mdx-two-v1 photos carry no EXIF 35 mm focal length (0 queries: never tried, no free-focal pose is ever shown); Sydney Opera House has no published model (no map); Frauenkirche Dresden has no eligible photo (every unplaced photo has a flagged camera or no focal length).

Verdict of D30 step 11: localize_photos is switched on only when every rule passes and every check whose role is guard or precondition passes; a FAIL or INSUFFICIENT of the rules (compare's verdict) or of such a check keeps it off, and the report says which and why.

rules.why: Hard gate: no localized pose shown wrong (the public row more than 10 m or 15 deg off the reference pose) on any building and repeat of either split, i.e. 0 pooled over dev and test. The loc_with_gps_conflict subset is part of it and is also reported alone (check loc_gps_conflict). A building without a reference pose (photo_pose_gt none: Sydney Opera House) has nothing to judge and is left out by name; every other building needs a value.

Hard gate: no localized pose looking 30 deg or more off its reference heading or standing 45 deg or more round the building from it, on every building and repeat; buildings without a reference pose left out as for photo_pose_loc_wrong.
Not worse than A (paired, --noise-factor 0: threshold 0.01), pooled and on every building.
Localization CPU at most 25 % of the runs' own CPU, per split (summed over the buildings, the median of each building's repeats), as the decisions define it.
Reported with B's pooled count and 95% Wilson interval; the pooled figure over both splits is check loc_coverage_pooled (INSUFFICIENT under 10 photos).
The gain the localizer brings (paired, --noise-factor 0): informational.
Localized poses with a reference pose: how much evidence the zero gate rests on.
Photos shown at all, never-uploaded ones failing.
EXIF poses: a localized pose replaces the photo's EXIF pose (poses.runs[].loc.replaced).
What the 'no crude pose' rule costs; localization does not change it except through photos it localizes.

checks.require: A and B are the same rescore but for --localize
checks.how: For each of the four pairs: provenance.rescored_from.sha256 equal (the D31 result), provenance.git.commit and code_sha256 equal and the tree clean, metric_schema_version 8, the same reference cache (every building's poses.reference report equal, India Gate fix version 2), B's provenance has localize and A's has not, compare reports effective_identical and no building whose inputs differ.
checks.why: The paired --noise-factor 0 reading holds only for two scores of one set of artefacts by one code.

checks.require: B differs from A only by the localized photos, on every building and repeat
checks.how: Per repeat (poses.runs[]): for every source s other than loc, B.by_source[s] + the photos B's loc.replaced moved from s equals A.by_source[s]; B.by_source.loc equals loc.shown; withheld, rounding and not_uploaded counts outside the localized photos equal; every metric outside the photo_pose_* group equal (geo, coverage, calibration, versions, request metrics and the copied ones).
checks.why: A difference elsewhere is a bug, not the localizer.

checks.how: Sum over every repeat of every building of both splits of B's poses.runs[].loc.gps_conflict (localized poses shown whose own GPS fix the localizer's GPS check flags far_from_gps or gps_and_compass): shown, gt, correct, wrong. wrong must be 0 (it is part of photo_pose_loc_wrong); the counts are reported.
checks.why: Crude-value item 5 of the D30 design: localized poses are shown far from their own GPS fix (recorded, not gated) only if none of them is wrong; one wrong would make the GPS conflict a gate (Params.loc_withhold_gps_conflict).

checks.require: reported, not judged; INSUFFICIENT under 10 photos
checks.how: photo_pose_loc_within_uncertainty / photo_pose_loc_gt of B summed over every repeat of every building of both splits (photo-runs), with its 95% Wilson interval (benchmark.wilson_interval); also per split from compare's info row.
checks.why: The range shown with a localized pose (hypot of the map's SfM sigma and 1.5 m / 0.7 deg) must be honest; with few reference photos the evidence is reported, not claimed.

checks.require: every localized synthetic photo within 1 m of the generator's truth and its heading within 1 deg of the truth once its map's own heading error is taken off; photo_pose_loc_correct = photo_pose_loc_gt
checks.how: synthetic-v1 B: each repeat's loc.json (synthetic-two-sides and synthetic-ring) against the generated manifest's true_enu and true_heading_deg (exact pose, before rounding); the map's heading error is the median, over the cameras of the model the photo was localized into, of their heading minus the truth (the generator's compass is 8 deg noisy, so a georegistered map is a few degrees off and the localizer inherits that); the result's photo_pose_loc_gt and photo_pose_loc_correct per repeat. As tests/test_benchmark.py::test_rescore_localize_scores_a_recorded_run checks on a fresh run of the same set.
checks.why: The one truth-checked localization: the product path is wired right before real photos are judged.

checks.require: what /poses shows of a fresh run with localization on equals what the harness scores, and its localizations equal the rescore's
checks.how: One fresh run (benchmark.py run --testset commons-ten-v1 --buildings florence-baptistery --repeat 1, a config with settings localize_photos true, from B's commit or a later one that changes no scoring): start the API on a copy of its data dir and GET /api/landmarks/<id>/poses. Per-source counts equal the run's photo_pose_sfm, _loc and _exif over the photos uploaded by as_of; every row equals photoposes.public_row of the internal pose; the leak scan of tests/test_api.py passes on it. rescore --localize of the same run gives the same LocRecords as the run's store (status, model, pose within 1 cm). photo_pose_not_uploaded is no larger than the D31 Baptistery runs' (the localize jobs must not eat the time cap).
checks.why: The rescore stands in for the product only if the product shows the same thing (D30 design, verification plan item 6).

checks.how: The fast suite at B's commit, in particular tests/test_api.py::test_no_public_get_serves_per_photo_data and the photoposes public_row tests; no loc.json, per-photo record or store id of a Commons run in the repository.
checks.why: Showing more poses must not show anything else.

checks.how: The fresh run's localize jobs (their CPU from the job log lines, 'job ... (localize ...) ... CPU-s') next to the rescore's photo_pose_loc_cpu_s for the same building and the run's cpu_time_s.
checks.why: The rescore's CPU is neither bound of a live run's (decisions); the fresh run measures the live one on one building.

checks.how: From B's poses.runs[].loc: records by status and reason (no_focal, focal_mismatch, too_few_matches, ...), queries by class, EXIF -> loc verdicts before and after (replaced), the per-map table (poses shown, right / wrong / outside the range, the map's own camera error), map features extracted, pairs; and photo_pose_withheld_right / _wrong next to them.
checks.why: The D30 report: what the localizer added, what it refused and what 'no crude pose' still costs.

predictions.basis: Counts of the product's candidate_maps / eligible / select_pairs on copies of the D31 runs (pure, no COLMAP; scratch d30/c9-rescore-criteria/probe/pairs.py, consent assumed for every accepted upload as the rescore assumes it) and the D30 step 7-8 smoke runs of the product localizer named in the decisions. Not B's result.

queries_per_repeat.commons-ten-v1 dev: Aachen 34 / 31 (r1 / r2), Brandenburg Gate 21 / 21, Florence Baptistery 11 / 11, Frauenkirche 0 / 0, Pisa 17 / 29
queries_per_repeat.commons-ten-v1 test: Hungarian Parliament 52 / 34, India Gate 13 / 13, Lincoln Memorial 44 / 44, Sagrada Familia 54 / 54, Sydney Opera House 0 / 0 (no map)

predictions.pairs_per_repeat: dev: Aachen 646 / 713, Brandenburg 1680 / 1680, Baptistery 396 / 396, Pisa 1530 / 2117 (median sum about 4580); test: Hungarian 832 / 1530, India Gate 442 / 442, Lincoln 440 / 440, Sagrada 2808 / 2808 (median sum about 4870); no candidate set reaches the 200-pair cap (largest 90 map photos)
predictions.localized: Smoke runs: synthetic-two-sides r1 1 of 1 (2071 / 2076 inliers); India Gate r1 1 of 13 (no reference pose); Pisa r1 1 of 17 (no reference pose); Florence Baptistery r1 2 of 11, the one with a reference pose right (4.72 m / 1.42 deg); Hungarian Parliament r1 0 of 52. Expected: a few localized poses per repeat, most without a reference pose.
predictions.photo_pose_loc_wrong: 0 on every building with a reference pose (the one localized reference photo seen so far is right); on the test split Sydney Opera House is left out (no photo_pose_gt), so the row reads '0 on 4 building(s); left out without photo_pose_gt: sydney-opera-house'. The same for photo_pose_loc_wrong_face.
predictions.photo_pose_loc_uncertainty_coverage: INSUFFICIENT: fewer than 10 localized reference photos expected over both splits
predictions.photo_pose_correct_rate_testset: a gain of 0-2 photos per split per repeat: below min_delta 0.01 on dev (about 230 reference photos per repeat)
predictions.photo_pose_loc_cpu_s: From the smoke runs' cost (India Gate r1 187 CPU-s for 47 images and 442 pairs, Pisa r1 777 CPU-s for 107 images and 1530 pairs: about 0.2-0.4 CPU-s per pair and 2 CPU-s per extracted image): dev about 1100-2000 CPU-s against a budget of 0.25 x 7410 = 1852 (either way); test about 1300-2300 CPU-s against 0.25 x 3356 = 839: the cost rule is predicted to FAIL on test (Sagrada Familia's 54 queries x 52 map photos alone are about 600-1200 CPU-s); synthetic-v1 a few CPU-s against 24; mdx-two-v1 0.
